question: What does a delta-neutral BTC/ETH funding carry on MEXC actually earn from today on, after fees, measured from the exchange's own public prices and funding prints?
venue: MEXC (spot 60m klines, USDT perpetual 1h klines, funding_rate history); the same venue as the other forward watches
allocation: half the capital per asset; per asset, half buys spot and half is margin for an equal-notional 1x short perpetual, so hedged notional = 2,500 USDT per asset
construction: carry.hedge_daily as in config/carry_study_v1.json: daily close = 1h bar ending 00:00 UTC; daily P&L per notional = spot return - perp return + funding settled in (t-1 00:00, t 00:00]; entered at the close of the start day; month-end reset to equal notional

costs.exit_cost: the report shows P&L both before and after a hypothetical exit at the latest close

warmup: prices and funding are fetched from 30 days before the start (the MEXC fetchers need at least 200 bars); nothing before the start is scored
